topic: K-Stick and the Tiny Umbrella That Only Covers His Cap

scenes.story_text: K-Stick sees raindrops and proudly opens a tiny umbrella, standing underneath it.
The umbrella covers only his red cap while the rest of his body gets lightly sprinkled. K-Stick keeps smiling and gives a confident thumbs-up.
He notices his cap is completely dry and proudly points at it like a weather expert.
A single raindrop lands on his nose, and the tiny umbrella instantly flips inside out. K-Stick calmly puts the umbrella on his cap like a hat and says, "Still protected!"
